note: Flux.rump and Flux.elevates bound every jet of scalp by a power of facescale, a polynomial in |z| and the placement count; this is the step's polynomial bound in a different packaging.

lemma rump (P : Teller G) (L : Side) (D : Patch) (hD : D.Branches P.bind G) (K γ W a : ℝ) (χ : Chi) (j : ℕ)
    {V u e : ℝ→ℝ} (h : Rate G L (-(1/2)) V) (hp : Rate G L (-(1/2)) u) (hv : ∀ᶠ x in atTop,0≤V x) (he : Rate G L 0 e)
    {η r S' : ℝ} (Y : ℝ) (p:Torch η r S') (d : ℝ) : ∃ (k:ℕ) (B:ℝ→ℝ), Rate G L 0 B ∧ ∀ᶠ x in atTop,
    ∀ (c f:Side) (S:StepData c f) (T:Tube G S), Works P L x S T→ S.patch=D → ShellAccess S G x W K γ →
      ∀ (E:Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (y:E) (U:E→Config G c) (F:Forest S.ratio) (X:Coat T F) (z:Air f G)
      (R:Rep G f), X.x=x → X.width=K → X.χ=χ → Port P L η r S' Y X → Intake P T x R → Mode U y j (V x) →
        Clutch X z a R.beta (|u x|) y j U (fun i=> steer X d (worldZ X R.beta z) (U i)) (fun i=>course X d R.beta z (U i)) →
        (∀ i, Brush j 1 (e x) (fun v=> steerJ X d (worldZ X R.beta z) (U v) i) y) →
          ∀ I, Brush j 1 (|B x| * facescale I z^k) (fun y=> scalp I X (U y) R.beta d z) y := by
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hX⟩:= Brush.neighborhood (k:=j) 0 Real.contDiff_exp.contDiffAt
  obtain ⟨M,hM,hY⟩:= Brush.neighborhood (k:=j) 1 (Real.contDiffAt_log.mpr (by norm_num))
  obtain ⟨A,R,hA,hR,hT⟩:= Blaze.vines P L D hD K γ W χ j p h hv 1
  obtain ⟨H,hH,hP⟩:= bounded_stencils P D hD
  let m:= carat D P L 0 H; let f:= m*m+1; let t:= tubularPrice G L; let g:=payE η r S' t
  let v x:= kernelGrowth (radiusB x) G (V x); let W' x:=driftP j (v x+v x); let b x:=facePrice j (radiusB x) t f g
  let B:=payE (retain η r S') (S'⁻¹/2) (1+g) t; let C x:= burst G L x * (|u x| + (|A x| +|A x|)); let F x y:= C x+y
  have hg:= (jet_growth G L h).weaken (b:=0) (by norm_num)
  have hz {v : ℝ→ℝ} (h : Rate G L (-(1/2)) v):= h.compare (v:=fun x=>|v x|) (Eventually.of_forall fun i=> (abs_abs _).le)
  have hc : Rate G L 0 C := by convert (burst_rate G L).mul ((hz hp).add ((hz hA).add (hz hA))) using 1; ring
  obtain ⟨k,T,ht,hF⟩ := (prices j (polynomial G L j t f g) he (show Rate G L 0 W' from (hg.add hg).mul_left _)
    ((Polyprice.fixed hc).combine (Polyprice.variableP G L)) M Q B).fees
  refine ⟨k,T,ht,hT.mono ?_⟩
  intro x hx c f' S T hh hv hS E _ _ y U F X z A' he hK hχ h hv hM' hB' hK' I
  have hΓ:= h.sails; have hX': X.manifest:= h.placed
  have hL:(vary X (U y)).manifest := hB'.tipped.symm ▸ hX'
  subst x
  have hc:Rotator P L η r S' Y (vary X (U y)) := by rw [hB'.tipped]; exact hΓ
  have hp := Gate.plates X D (by assumption) hh.length_eq hΓ.room hM' H hH (hP _ _ S T (by assumption) hh.funds) (le_refl 0) P.top.width_pos
  have hx' := hx c _ S T (by assumption) hh hS F X E U y rfl hK hχ hM' hL hc.scale
  let w := facescale I z
  have he := (hK' (0,0)).pos; have hy:= hF X.x w (expenses I z).1; rw [abs_of_nonneg he] at hy
  refine (elevates I hY.self_of_nhds hX.self_of_nhds hc hp hx'.1 (abs_nonneg _) hB' hK' he (b:=C X.x+w) ?_).climb le_rfl ((le_abs_self _).trans hy)
  apply add_le_add_left
  unfold C
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (burst_h (L:=L) (hh.length_eq ▸ hv.window.2)) (add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)))

proof_context.conclusion: rump shows every jet of scalp up to order j is bounded by |B x| times a power of facescale, with B of rate 0, under the steer and clutch hypotheses.

lemma elevates {F B : ℝ} (hF : Brush j F 1 Real.log 1) (hB : Brush j B 1 Real.exp 0) (hp : Rotator P L η r Q Y (vary X (C x)))
    (he : Tablet j 0 v d (fun i=> (vary X (C i)).plate) (along S) (along S) x) (hL : ∀ i, Brush j A 1 (fun y=>voltage (vary X (C y)) i) x) (hA : 0≤A)
    (hq : Clutch X w a β t x j C (fun v=> steer X p (worldZ X β w) (C v)) (fun v=>course X p β w (C v))) (h : ∀ i,Brush j 1 q
    (fun v=>steerJ X p (worldZ X β w) (C v) i) x) (hh : 0≤q) (hw : (gStep β)⁻¹*(t+(A+A))+facescale I w≤b):
    let m:=tubularPrice G L; let z:=payE η r Q m; let f:=facePrice j X.B m v z; let t:= facescale I w
    let D:= seismic j F B f (payE (retain η r Q) (Q⁻¹/2) (1+z) m) (driftP j d) b t
    Brush j 1 (t*q+D) (fun y=> scalp I X (C y) β p w) x := by
  intro m z f' t' D
  let s v:=course X p β w (C v); let i:=lensS I G; let n(v):= Pond.swim i (s v); let Y(v):= Pond.circuit i (vary X (C v)).relating
  have he:= feast X I C hp he
  have hh' : 0≤b := by
    have ht:= hq.price; have hg:0 < (gStep β)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq.beta))
    have hh := (expenses I w).1; exact le_trans (by positivity) hw
  have hz := oriflamme (Ω:=n) hF hB he (own_mat hp I) (hp.fullC.submatrix Subtype.val_injective) (fun i=> (meager hq I hL hA i).climb hw le_rfl) hh'
  let F' := payE (retain η r Q) (Q⁻¹/2) (1+z) m
  have hy : 0≤F' := (own_mat hp I).disc
  let M:ℝ:= (lensS I G).card; let K:=seismic j F B f' F' (driftP j d) b M
  have hu : Brush j 1 K (fun y=> lens₀ (circuit i (vary X (C y)).relating) (n y)/lens₀ (circuit i X.relating) (Pond.swim i w)) x := by
    have hf:n x= Pond.swim i w := congr_arg (Pond.swim i) hq.birth
    dsimp only at hz; rw [hq.tipped,hf,Fintype.card_coe] at hz; exact hz
  have hX : 0≤driftP j d:= he.pos; have hY:= he.basis
  have h : Brush j 1 ((I.card:ℝ)*q) (fun y=> jacL I X p β (C y) w) x := by
    simpa only [sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul, prod_const_one] using! Brush.all_prod I _ _ _ (fun i (_:i∈I)=> h i)
  refine (h.paints hu).climb (one_mul _).le (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (expenses I w).2.1 hh) ?_)
  unfold D K seismic; dsimp only
  let H := driftP j d; have he:=hF.nonneg; have hx:=hB.nonneg; have hn := (expenses I w).2.2.1
  have hg : 0≤token j f' F' := by unfold token; exact sum_nonneg fun _ _=> by change 0≤ (f'*F'+1)^_*F'; positivity
  have hm:0≤M := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hp : 0≤ f':=hY
  change M ≤ t' at hn
  have hh : cenote j M F' f' H≤cenote j t' F' f' H := by unfold cenote; gcongr
  have hy : 0≤cenote j M F' f' H := by unfold cenote; positivity
  have hΘ:0≤driftP j (driftP j d):= mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hX
  gcongr

proof_context.conclusion: elevates composes the log and exp jet bounds with the clutch data to bound the jets of scalp by t*q plus an explicit seismic term in the face price.
